title: console list page: the saved-view tab strip inside the toolbar's leading slot folds to one tab and "N more" at 1440 — the bar's root does not grow, so the width the fit is derived from is its own content's width (regression of #12440)
body:
Filing gate ① (a product defect, measured on `main`), filed on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, finding F1), and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444. A regression of #12440 (PR #12473, `d4bc81e`). Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/plugin-view` (one class on one element, one test), size S.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "saved view tab strip folds to one tab and N more inside the list toolbar leading slot width fit ViewTabBar flex-1 regression" → 10, top 8 read: #12504 (open, retiring the view-write family), #12440 and #12423 (closed, this strip's two parents), #11992, #11395, #10987, #10209, #2959 (closed, unrelated). None is this card.

## What happens

On the HotCRM Leads list at 1440 px the tab strip shows one tab, "All Leads", and a "7 more" trigger, although the toolbar's leading slot is 873 px wide and all seven tabs fit in it (the design reference on #12444 shows them). Accounts shows "All Accounts · 5 more", Opportunities "Open Deals · 9 more", Tasks "My Open Tasks · 7 more". A window resize of one pixel changes the count to two; shrinking to 1024 and back leaves one. The same page, loaded on another run, showed all seven: the count depends on when the strip was measured.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. `packages/plugin-view/src/ViewTabBar.tsx` line 977: the bar's root is `flex min-w-0 items-center gap-0.5 -mb-px`, with no `flex-1` or `w-full`. Line 985: the strip inside it is `flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-0.5 overflow-x-clip`. Lines 424–428: `fitFromWidths` derives the count from `layoutWidth(stripRef.current)`; lines 444–452: a `ResizeObserver` on the strip re-fits on every size change.
2. `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` line 4986: the host slot is `flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center` (`data-testid="list-toolbar-leading"`), inside the toolbar's left group (`flex flex-1 … min-w-0`).
3. `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` line 3267 passes `ViewTabBar` into that slot with no `className`.
4. Browser reading (1440, Leads): computed `flex-grow` down the chain is strip 1 → bar **0** → leading slot 1 → left group 1; widths 190 → 224 → 873 → 873 px. On the run where seven tabs showed, the strip measured 663 px inside a 697 px bar: the bar's width is the sum of whatever tabs are drawn.

So inside the slot the bar is content-sized, the strip's `flex-1` is a share of its own content's width, and the fit is self-referential: once a measure happens while one tab is drawn (the strip is 190 px), one tab is all that fits, and the observer confirms it on every resize. Before #12440 the bar sat in a row of its own and took the row's width.

## What to build

1. The bar's root takes its container's width when hosted in a flex slot: `flex-1 min-w-0` on the root (or the equivalent `w-full`), so the strip's width is the slot's free width whatever is drawn in it. No change to the fit algorithm, the overflow trigger or the host slot.
2. A test in `packages/plugin-view` that mounts the bar inside a fixed-width flex host (the slot's classes) with the measured widths stubbed, and pins that the visible count follows the host's width, not the drawn tabs' width: at an 852 px host with seven 90 px tabs, all seven show; at 400 px, four show and "3 more"; growing the host back re-fits to seven.

## Acceptance

- The test above, green; the existing `ViewTabBar` fit tests unchanged.
- Browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on the HotCRM Leads list: all seven tabs show with no overflow trigger (the #12444 reference's main board); at 1024 four tabs and "3 more" (the laptop board); a 1440 → 1439 → 1440 resize ends with seven; a reload ends with seven.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (patch) for `@object-ui/plugin-view`.

## Out of scope

- The fit algorithm, the "N more" menu, the mobile view picker; the #12440 host slot's own classes.

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
